header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: it is from Allah Ta'ala. So let him praise Allah Ta'ala for it. And let him tell that dream to others. If he sees a bad dream, it is from Shaytan. Let him ask Allah Ta'ala for protection from the evil of that dream. If he does not tell it to anyone, the bad dream will do him no harm” — Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say this.

blocks.text: Note:- To seek protection with Allah Ta'ala, say ()اَعْوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنْ شَرِّهَا”I seek protection with Allah Ta'ala from the evil of this dream”.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ يَقُولُ: اَلرُّؤْيَا مِنَ اللهِ وَالْحُلْمُ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِذَا رَأَي أَحَدُكُمْ شَيْئاً يَكْرَهُهُ فَلْيَنْفِثْ حِيَنَ يَسْتَيْقِظُ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَيَتَعَوَّذْ مِنْ شَرِّهَا فَإِنَّهَا لَا تَضُرُّهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب النفث في الرقية رقم:٥٧٤٧
blocks.tamil_translation: “A good dream is from Allah Ta'ala, and a bad (frightening) dream is from Shaytan. If any of you sees something disliked in a dream, let him get up at that moment, spit (to his left) three times, and ask Allah Ta'ala for protection from the evil of that dream. If he does so, that dream will not harm him” — Hazrat Abu Qatadah (RA) narrates that he heard Rasulullah ﷺ say this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِذَا أَوَي أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَي فِرَاشِهِ اِبْتَدَرَهُ مَلَكٌ وَشَيْطَانٌ يَقُولُ الشَّيْطَانُ: اِخْتِمْ بِشَرٍّ وَيَقُولُ الْمَلَكُ: اِخْتِمْ بِخَيْرٍ فَإِنْ ذَكَرَ اللهَ ذَهَبَ الشَّيْطَانُ وَبَاتَ الْمَلَكُ يَكْلَؤُهُ وَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ اِبْتَدَرَهُ مَلَكٌ وَشَيْطَانٌ يَقُولُ الشَّيْطَانُ: اِفْتَحْ بِشَرٍّ
